chapter: Early bands, Calloway to Basie and Kansas City (third typescript)
title: Blanche Calloway's records and Line of Jive
summary: Morgenstern has a Calloway record he thinks has Dickenson on it; Dickenson has never heard it and asks for a cassette.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Just to backtrack a moment -- to Blanche Calloway -- I think you got to make some records with that band.
Yeah. But I never did hear any of them -- the ones I made. I --
You do have one -- is that right?
What is it -- what's the name?
It came out recently. It came out in one of those --
I wish you would make me a cassette of it.
Sure. I'll bring it around the next time --
Yeah, make me a little cassette -- I'd like to hear that.
It sounds like a good band.
